dedupe_keys.name: eustace global land station daily temperature version 1 1

description: The EUSTACE consortium assembled global daily maximum and minimum air temperatures from meteorological stations for 1850–2015 and published them through CEDA. Source collections include GHCN-Daily, ECA&D, ISTI, DECADE and rescued ERA-CLIM observations. Duplicate and unreliable sources were removed, and additional variables describe quality, reporting resolution and detected non-climatic discontinuities. NetCDF data are freely accessible under the Non-Commercial Government Licence v2.0. They can evaluate historical heat and cold episodes used in building-energy or infrastructure climate-risk simulations. This station product complements the separate EUSTACE gridded reconstruction. Version 1.1 corrects a time-coordinate bug in version 1.0; the original files were shifted by 4,748 days. Data values are otherwise unchanged. Some contributing observations cannot be redistributed because of their licences. Identified breakpoints also remain a limitation for trend studies: detection metadata do not establish that all station series have been homogenised.
